hero.eyebrow: An AI marketing assistant for small shops

features.title: From the first post idea to the weekly report
features.subtitle: Instead of jumping between five apps, all of your marketing happens in one place, in your shop's language.

writing.title: Posts that write themselves
writing.body: The AI writes in your dialect and your shop's tone, from your real products and offers, and avoids the words you don't like.

publishing.title: Scheduled at the best time
publishing.body: Approve a post and it goes out on Instagram and Facebook when your audience is most active.

inbox.body: Comments and messages are sorted (question, complaint, order) with a ready reply you can edit and send in one click.

campaigns.body: Set the goal and get a full plan: how many posts, which formats and on which days.

competitors.title: An eye on competitors
competitors.body: Follow competitor accounts, see what works for them and turn it into ideas that fit your shop.

reports.title: A weekly report in plain words
reports.body: What worked, what didn't and what to do next, without complicated numbers.

stack.title: A modern, reliable stack
stack.subtitle: A fast interface in Arabic and English, a secure API that keeps every shop's data apart, and automatic checks on every change.
